title: Healthcare Patient Management & AI Report Analysis Platform
summary: FastAPI-based healthcare backend that manages patient profiles, doctor booking and care plans, and uses OCR, LLMs and RAG to extract medical values, summarize reports and answer questions from patient records.
highlights: Secure REST APIs for patient profiles, report upload, doctor booking and care plans
JWT authentication with role-based access for patients and doctors
OCR and LLM pipeline to extract medical values and generate report summaries
RAG-based question answering over patient records using pgvector
Background report processing with Celery and Redis

title: Centralized Cloud Integration & Authorization System
summary: FastAPI backend that centralizes manufacturing data and keeps it synchronized across multiple assembly areas, secured with JWT and role-based access.
highlights: REST APIs for manufacturing data integration and synchronization
AWS services integrated through Boto3
JWT authentication with role-based authorization

title: Manufacturing & Mobile Assembly Management System
summary: Django REST APIs powering component production, unique ID generation, scanning and component assignment on the assembly line.
highlights: Assembly validation, duplicate prevention and missing-component checks
Database transactions to keep production data consistent

title: Banking Document Processing & PDF Automation
summary: Replaced a legacy Press Script workflow with Python automation for parsing banking and loan documents and generating PDFs.
highlights: Regex-based extraction across TXT, DAT, JSON, TIF and STR files
Automated formatting, data processing and PDF generation with FPDF
Reusable scripts that cut manual effort

title: Driver Drowsiness & Yawning Detection
summary: Real-time computer-vision system built during college that watches the driver's face and raises an alert when it detects drowsiness or yawning.
highlights: Live webcam monitoring of eyes and mouth
Alert triggered before fatigue becomes dangerous

title: This Portfolio Website
summary: The site you are on: a FastAPI app with a 3D scroll-driven background, light/dark themes, a project API and a contact form that stores enquiries and emails them to me.
highlights: Async FastAPI + SQLAlchemy + PostgreSQL
Contact form with validation, spam protection, rate limiting and email alerts
Three.js, GSAP and Lenis for scroll-based motion

title: Smart Video Frame Tagger
summary: AI-powered video analytics platform that extracts video frames, detects objects and generates searchable metadata using computer vision and Generative AI.
highlights: Grounding DINO for text-prompt-based object detection
OpenCV and FFmpeg for video processing and frame extraction
Vector embeddings with FAISS and ChromaDB for semantic search
Timestamp-based frame retrieval with visual previews

title: Weather Forecast Application
summary: A weather application that fetches real-time weather information from external APIs and displays current conditions and forecasts based on location.
highlights: Search weather by city name
Display temperature and humidity
Show wind speed and weather conditions
Integrate third-party weather APIs

title: Employee Management System
summary: A simple web application built with Django to manage employee information, department details, and employee records.
highlights: Add and manage employee details
Update employee information
View employee records
Search employees by name or department
